info.title: Foxfleet hub API
info.description: The contract shared by the hub, the web app and the Android app. Contract tests (contract/run.mjs) run against the real hub and the web mock hub.

servers.description: Your hub; clients ask for the address on first launch

get.summary: Connected machines (computers running the connector) and their profiles.

post.summary: Create a 15-minute, single-use pairing code for connecting a machine (or re-pairing one with machineId).

get.summary: Live status of a pairing code: waiting, paired (with the machine and its profiles) or expired.

post.summary: Called by the connector (no login): exchanges a pairing code once for a machine token.

delete.summary: Revoke a machine: its token stops working, it disconnects and its agents are removed.

post.summary: Rotate: the current token dies now; the returned pairing code re-pairs the same machine (agents stay).

get.summary: Liveness
Who am I, and does this hub need setup? Safe to call unauthenticated (also the hub-address probe).

post.summary: First-run owner creation (only while setupRequired).
Sign in. client=app returns a bearer token; web gets a cookie.
Join with an invite (or openly, per registration mode).
Sign out this device.
Sign out every device.

get.summary: Signed-in devices.

post.summary: Change password; other devices are signed out.

get.summary: Registration mode (owner).
Link + QR for pairing a phone with this hub (owner).
Open invites (owner).

post.summary: Create an invite; the code appears once, inside the link (owner).

get.summary: All accounts (owner).

patch.summary: Disable or enable a user (owner; the owner cannot be disabled).

get.summary: Provider kinds and their form schema; clients render add/edit forms from this.
Saved agents. Secrets and addresses are never returned, only has* flags.

post.summary: Add an agent. Connector bootstrap or mailbox token is returned once.

put.summary: Edit an agent. Omitted write-only fields keep their saved value.

delete.summary: Remove an agent and its secrets.

post.summary: Persist agent order.
Probe a draft or saved agent without saving.
New connector bootstrap (Hermes connector) or mailbox token; the old one stops working.

get.summary: Fleet with live status and capabilities.
Past sessions, newest activity first. Hermes agents: the dashboard's sessions. API-key agents: hub-stored history (see /api/history/settings).
One page of a conversation, normalised (tool calls folded into the assistant turn, tags and hidden rows removed). offset counts back from the newest message; each page is chronological.
Skill names for / and # autocomplete.

post.summary: OpenAI-style chat, streamed as Server-Sent Events (text/event-stream). Events: data chunks with choices[].delta.content / reasoning_content, `hermes.tool.progress`, `[DONE]`. Session id in X-Hermes-Session-Id.
post.description: For a native-capable Hermes agent (capabilities.nativeUi) the hub routes this to the native session server-side: same shapes, the reply is followed as a run, and extra SSE events foxfleet.request / foxfleet.request_closed / foxfleet.ack carry cards and Hermes acknowledgements.

post.summary: Upload (application/octet-stream body, ?name=&type=) into the agent's managed files.

get.summary: Screen availability and who holds control.

post.summary: Start the virtual screen.
Mint a single-use (30 s) ticket for the screen WebSocket: wss://hub/api/agents/{name}/screen/ws?ticket=…
Take control (auto hand-back at autoHandBackAt).
Hand control back to the agent.

get.summary: Fetch a remote https image for Markdown through the hub (SSRF-checked: public addresses only, https:443, no SVG, 8 MB, 10 s).
Chat runs of this agent still held by the hub (running, or finished within the last 10 minutes). A run keeps going if the client disconnects.

Replays a run's events after the cursor (?after=N or Last-Event-ID) and follows it live. Events carry `id: N`; `foxfleet.gap` says older events were dropped from the bounded log; `foxfleet.run` says the run was stopped or failed.

post.summary: Stop the run. Resolves once termination is confirmed (confirmed=true) or reports the truth when it is not (confirmed=false, the run keeps going). Halts queue draining.

get.summary: History retention for the signed-in user.

retentionDays.description: How long the hub keeps chat history for API-key agents (this user). 0 = keep nothing.
How long the hub keeps chat history for API-key agents (this user). 0 = keep nothing.
How long the hub keeps chat history for API-key agents (this user). 0 = keep nothing.

get.summary: Slash commands for this agent. Hermes starts from the bundled registry. A connected gateway adds that profile's skills and any extra names, which stay non-executable. Pass session to scope the live catalog to that chat. Other kinds: the local chat commands.

parameters.name: session
parameters.description: Stored chat id. When the hub knows that chat's runtime session, the live catalog is read in that session.

availability.description: app: Foxfleet runs it; chat: sent as a message; unavailable: terminal/platform only

skills.description: Skill names from the live catalog, when a gateway answered.

warning.description: Live catalog warning, such as a skill-discovery failure.

post.summary: Send a message even while the agent is replying. Persisted and acknowledged first; follow the reply with /runs/{id}/events. client_id makes retries idempotent.

mode.description: Apps send a plain message as `interrupt` (stop, then send) to agents the hub queues for, and as `auto` to native Hermes sessions (Hermes applies its own busy_input_mode and the answer is shown on the message). `steer` and `queue` come from the typed /steer and /queue commands.

post.description: For a native-capable Hermes agent (capabilities.nativeUi) the hub routes this to the native session server-side: same shapes, the reply is followed as a run, and extra SSE events foxfleet.request / foxfleet.request_closed / foxfleet.ack carry cards and Hermes acknowledgements.

get.summary: The persisted message queue of one conversation
get.description: For a native-capable Hermes agent (capabilities.nativeUi) the hub routes this to the native session server-side: same shapes, the reply is followed as a run, and extra SSE events foxfleet.request / foxfleet.request_closed / foxfleet.ack carry cards and Hermes acknowledgements.

post.summary: Resume automatic queue draining after Stop or a hub restart

delete.summary: Remove a message that is still waiting in the queue

get.summary: Native Hermes UI gateway: is it available for this agent (Hermes through a connected machine)

post.summary: Create a native session
Attach to the live owner (never starts another agent); restores partial answer, queued prompts and open requests

get.summary: Journaled messages of a session

post.summary: Send a message (auto, queue, steer, interrupt); the response carries the upstream acknowledgement
Interrupt the running turn

get.summary: SSE stream foxfleet.native/1 (turn.start, message.delta, reasoning, tool.start/progress/end, turn.end, ack, request.open, request.cancel, request.answered, status, owner.down, link). `after` or Last-Event-ID resumes from a hub cursor; foxfleet.gap means refetch state.

post.summary: Answer an approval or clarification once, by request id
Switch the model for this session only

get.summary: Provider and model choices from the live Hermes picker
Slash commands from the live Hermes registry
The Hermes PROFILE-wide default for messages sent while it works (display.busy_input_mode)

post.summary: Change the profile default. Affects every chat of the profile; requires confirm:true

session.name: foxfleet_session
session.description: Web: HttpOnly cookie. Apps send the token from login(client=app) as `Authorization: Bearer`.

acceptedTerms.description: Terms version this user accepted at sign-up, if recorded.

termsVersion.description: Current version label of the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.

acceptedTerms.description: Version label of the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy the person accepted (see termsVersion in GET /api/auth). Optional for older clients; the hub records version and time.
Version label of the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy the person accepted (see termsVersion in GET /api/auth). Optional for older clients; the hub records version and time.

busy.description: Send modes this agent supports while it is replying

nativeRuns.description: Hermes advertises native run controls (run_submission, run_events_sse, run_steer, run_stop)

nativeUi.description: The machine connector can drive a native Hermes UI gateway for this profile (preferred over /v1/runs and chat completions)

Connection.description: Plain fields plus hasX flags for write-only ones. Never carries secrets or addresses.

ack.description: What Hermes itself answered (native sessions). Shown as received, never predicted; null until it answered.

halted.description: Automatic draining is paused (after Stop or a hub restart) until resume or a new message

open_requests.description: Native sessions: cards that are still open, so a reload or a second device shows them again

can_cancel.description: False when the agent keeps the queue itself (Hermes): DELETE /queue/{id} answers 409

ack.description: What Hermes answered: streaming, queued, steered, redirected, rejected or reconciled. Never predicted.

OpenRequest.description: A question or approval the agent waits on. Answer once with POST /api/agents/{name}/native/sessions/{sid}/requests/{rid}. Other request kinds are declined upstream and never listed.
